credentials.description: license key, sent as Authorization: Basic <license key> (the key as is, not base64 of user:password)
website ID of your LengoPay account, sent with the request (body field websiteid, or path segment for get_balance), separate from the license key

example_prompt: Add LengoPay mobile money collection to my checkout.

amount.description: Payment amount as a numeric string (e.g. "1000").

websiteid.description: Unique site identifier (Site ID in the LengoPay dashboard).

type_account.description: Mobile network type for the payment (e.g. "lp-om-gn" for Orange Money Guinea, "lp-momo-gn" for MTN MoMo Guinea).

account.description: Phone number of the payment recipient (e.g. "620124578").

callback_url.description: HTTPS URL to receive the final status notification. Optional but strongly recommended.

status.description: Status of the request's receipt (not of the final payment).

pay_id.description: Unique transaction identifier, base64-encoded. Present if status = Success.

message.description: Message describing the outcome of the request's receipt.

gotchas: amount must be a numeric string (e.g. "1000"), not a number. Passing a number causes a 400 error.
The "Success" status in the response only indicates that the request was received, not that the payment has been made. Use cashin_status or the callback to get the final result.
The returned pay_id is base64-encoded — keep it as is to use it in cashin_status, without decoding.
callback_url must be a valid HTTPS URL. HTTP URLs are silently ignored.
type_account must match the network of the account number (e.g. do not use lp-om-gn for an MTN number).
